required_fixes: Fixed critical bug in citation_embeddings.py: node2vec library path returned Word2Vec model instead of (matrix, vocab) tuple. Now extracts embedding matrix and vocab dict to match manual_node2vec interface.
claim_ceiling: Language-dominated baseline embeddings do not support legally coherent fractal mapping. Two independent methods improve the legal/language purity ratio by ~20% but no method achieves ratio >1.0.
evidence_summary: Repair cycle for run 33021595718. Diagnosed two orchestration failures: (1) scope violation — researcher committed .opencode/agents/* changes (external_directory permissions for /tmp/lex_*) outside fractal_map/* write scope, same class as prior run 33020332703; (2) missing audit gate and state file overwrite without accumulated evidence_refs. All 22 experimental artifacts verified present and well-formed (JSON valid, npy shapes correct, Python syntax valid). Independent recomputation confirms all material quantitative claims: baseline purity 0.350, center-projected ratio 0.431 (+20%), TF-IDF Erwaegungen purity 0.385 (+10%), hierarchy NMI 0.73-0.91 baseline / 0.86-0.90 debiased. One discrepancy noted: sachverhalt_erwaegungen legal_purity 0.344 (unified, 857 decisions) vs 0.377 (individual, 1000 decisions) — explained by unified evaluation restricting to common decision set for fair comparison. Critical bug fixed: citation_embeddings.py node2vec library path now returns (matrix, vocab) tuple matching manual_node2vec interface. Scope violation reverted: .opencode/agents/* restored to prior accepted state. State file updated with accumulated evidence_refs from all prior cycles. Snapshot is audit-ready.
